name: Fujian Qingshan Paper Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Fujian Qingshan Paper Industry Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and sale of pulp and paper products in China. The company offers pulp products, including natural wood pulp, bleached wood pulp, natural bamboo pulp, bleached bamboo pulp, wood dissolving pulp, and bamboo dissolving pulp; paper bags, composite base paper, tote bags, and kraft paper; paper product processing; pharmaceutical products; optoelectronic devices; and timber, and bamboo products.
